Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED NOTES (observed unless marked guess/uncertain)

CONTROLS: WASD moves; arrow keys fire; move+fire simultaneously works. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse) that damages self; warping does not outrun the fuse (tested earlier). Q/Space do nothing.

HATCH/WARP MECHANICS (re-confirmed many times): warping needs near-exact x-centering plus a sustained walk started ~0.1-0.2 units from the frame. Standing ON the frame blocks the warp—back off ~0.15, re-center, hold ~1.0-1.2s; multiple attempts are normal. A diagonal walk into the frame from the top row also triggered warps. Rocks can sit directly below a hatch and block vertical approach; route along the top row and walk sideways into the frame.

TECH X: CONFIRMED again this run—entering the two-poop room auto-grants Tech X ('Laser ring Tears'); re-obtainable there. Earlier a run had no pedestal and plain tears, so verify on entry.

LASERS (Tech X): firing creates a ~1s lingering laser ring at a fixed offset (~0.15-0.2 units) along the firing row/column; rocks block it; alignment matters. Rocks are NOT destroyed by lasers. The red squiggly ring is my own laser, not a lock marker/telegraph (uncertain). In the rock field an upward laser column hit a white-faced chaser (blood visible) and killed it, but I still lost half a heart to it first; chasers close fast, so only fight at range with correct row/column aim.

ROUTE/MAP (all transitions observed this run unless noted):
- Start/mural room (floor start, instruction murals): top dark hatch x~0.50 <-> rock field; bottom hatch x~0.50 <-> torch room; right-side dark doorway (y~0.40-0.55, x~0.78-0.82) <-> dark chest room. Straight or diagonal w+d pushes against the right doorway did not transition immediately, but a diagonal s+d entry DID—whether it needs diagonal input or just y-alignment is unresolved (guess).
- Rock field (above start room): bottom hatch ~x0.50 <-> start room; top hatch x~0.50 <-> TNT room; keyhole door on left wall ~x0.19-0.20, y~0.44-0.48. Known hazards here: white-faced chasers that pursue fast and cluster near hatches, green glowing blobs that expand into large damaging bursts, small spiky pellets (guess: turret), spiked wheels, blue-tear shooters, a spiked-ring enemy, and a spiked black rock ring with a gray enemy at room center. Severe heart drainer; do not loiter.
- Torch room (below start room this run): top dark hatch x~0.50 <-> start room; gold bottom-center hatch x~0.50 <-> two-poop room (approach centered from ~0.1-0.15 above). Center column is rock-choked; safe left lane x~0.31-0.42 full height and right lane x~0.63 traversable. Center gray chest is sealed by indestructible rocks—ABANDON. Corner torches damage on touch. Small dark specks near left wall (~0.30, 0.43) treated as minor hazards.
- Two-poop room: only exit is top crown/gold hatch x~0.50, y~0.09-0.17 (approach from ~0.1 below; standing on frame blocks). Tech X auto-grants on entry. Poop piles are harmless and regenerate. Center rock vanished on a later visit (cause unknown; NOT attributable to lasers).
- TNT room: TNT barrels line left wall and mid-room, block movement, inert (don't shoot point-blank); red-lidded brown barrels near left wall (guess: key-locked); top dark hatch x~0.50 <-> pink-enemy room; bottom hatch <-> rock field. A bomb-holding walking enemy mid-room survived ~5-6 vertical tear volleys with no visible reaction; unclear if armored/offset hitbox—treat as dangerous.
- Pink-enemy rock room (TNT top hatch): two pink fat enemies left-center; rock wall ring on right with three dark teardrop objects and a small blue creature (uncertain).

DARK CHEST ROOM: two red-lidded unspiked chests up top (~0.33,0.33 and ~0.67,0.33) do NOT open on contact; central spiked chest is untouchable and emits spike projectiles; small black cat-like chasers roam (~0.33 and ~0.66 at y~0.50) and a yellow-green blob hazard sits left (~0.26,0.48). Entering at 1 heart is effectively lethal—I died here at 0 hearts (empty heart outlines + blood-splatter death visual).

KEY: a key counter read 01 earlier. KEYHOLE DOOR TESTED AND FAILED: with key 01, adjacent to the rock-field left-wall keyhole, pressing into it, aligning vertically, and firing left did NOT open it and did NOT consume the key. Meeting condition UNRESOLVED.

CHESTS/CONTAINERS: gray chests open by contact. Left-wall gray plates in the TNT room are inert decor. Coin pot in the two-poop room breaks on contact for a coin.

BOMBS: Bombing the two-poop room center rock cost a heart and broke nothing—rocks judged indestructible. Never bomb at low health or adjacent to self.

HAZARDS/HEARTS: Green glowing blobs damage on contact, transform (winged/spread/large fast forms), and can burst over large areas. Damage lands faster than warps can be set up. A mid-fight heart refill (1->2) was seen once; mechanism uncertain (possibly dropped pickup).

DEATH LESSONS: entering enemy rooms without thinning from the doorway is fatal; at 1 or half a heart any contact ends the run—flee through a hatch/exit rather than fight. The dark chest room is a death trap at low health.

UNRESOLVED: keyhole door opening condition; red-lidded chests/barrels; bomb-walker armor/hitbox; heart-refill mechanism; meaning of the red laser ring (uncertain); two-poop center-rock disappearance cause; whether the start-room right doorway requires diagonal entry or exact y-alignment.
